bibliographic_correction: The supplied manuscript prints the issue-wide page range 2801–3294. INFORMS gives article pages 3133–3141.

dependent_variables: Change in operating income after depreciation
original_future_performance_test.posting_measure: Change in average active postings during the first three months of fiscal t+1 relative to the corresponding months of t, scaled by assets[t], then ranked following the manuscript’s convention
controls: lagged asset-scaled change in capital expenditure

our_proposed_extension.status: NOT ESTIMATED: original dataset audited; jobs_count is undated profile metadata repeated over review years, not historical posting counts.

measures.G_B: Broader ghost-intensity proxy based on Revelio postings and subsequent hiring (research-plan label HJPR)
measures.G_I: Interview-stage perceived ghost-intensity proxy (research-plan label HJPR_Int)

our_proposed_extension.orientation: Higher G means more ghost activity. The raw hires/postings ratio has the opposite orientation; define the delivered proxy before estimation and do not assume a bounded 1-minus-ratio transformation.
our_proposed_extension.baseline: Replicate the positive JP-to-future-operations relation using the Lourie variables, timing, controls, industry/year effects and firm-clustered errors.
our_proposed_extension.equation: DeltaY = alpha + beta*JP + gamma_k*G_k + delta_k*(JP*G_k) + theta*X + industry FE + year FE + error, k in {broader, interview}
our_proposed_extension.joint_comparison: Where common coverage permits, include both ghost main effects and both JP interactions; distinguish this from the separate specifications.

predictions.broader_delta: negative when higher values mean more ghost intensity
predictions.interview_delta: negative when higher values mean more ghost intensity
predictions.relative_delta_ordering: Not prespecified by the research plan; compare on a common sample.

our_proposed_extension.timing: Define proxy measurement windows in advance and avoid using the same subsequent hiring observations as both proxy inputs and independent validation outcomes.
our_proposed_extension.priority: Employment, SG&A, revenue and operating earnings first; market reactions later after event-window and news-control choices.
our_proposed_extension.supporting_tests: Existing growth, morale, productivity, monitoring and cost tests remain additional analyses.
our_proposed_extension.not_the_design: Do not mechanically remove or discount posting counts using the interview-review share.

additional_external_check: Matched hires per posting over six months by company, occupation/role, seniority and location, following the logic described in Revelio’s article; separate common review-source evidence from independent worker-start evidence.
data_needed: Revelio posting histories and subsequent hiring evidence, with firm links, occupation/location information, coverage dates and the delivered broader ghost-proxy definition
Posting opening/closing dates, occupation/skills and geography for duration and composition checks
Worker position starts for independent hiring-conversion checks
Independent human labels of narratives for classification precision/recall
data_currently_supplied: Annual financial statements and selected analyst/ownership files
not_substitutes: Interview-review counts are not active-posting counts
Compustat net employment change is not gross hiring or departures
A significant or insignificant investment coefficient does not validate ghost-job identification
design_basis: Verified two-measure research specification: Lourie baseline, broader and interview-stage ghost proxies, and posting interactions.
requested_validation_source: Original interview-based dataset and original financial links, per user instruction. Existing displayed supporting tables retain their separately reported sample.

original_dataset_check.minimum_for_interview_check: Monthly active-posting counts, observation dates, and employer identifiers matching the original panel. Gross hiring histories are not required for this interaction when annual employment outcomes are available.
original_dataset_check.additional_for_broader_proxy: Matched subsequent hires or a documented delivered posting-to-hire proxy with non-overlapping validation windows.

interview_activity_adaptation.status: COMPLETED using original dataset; separate from the unestimated exact posting tests.
interview_activity_adaptation.findings: Inconsistent baseline activity signal; no clear weakening by the ghost measure; all four interaction Holm p-values equal 1.0.
interview_activity_adaptation.scoring_reproducibility: 218717 original review scores and flags reproduced exactly.
interview_activity_adaptation.human_validation: 200-review blinded sample prepared; human coding not completed.

exploratory_cross_review_check.status: Completed after inconclusive operating checks; retained those results.
exploratory_cross_review_check.finding: Limited agreement across companies; no clear within-company evidence; not classification accuracy or Lourie replication.

current_main_validation.source: Latest user instruction: emphasize separate-review agreement.
current_main_validation.status: Main validation section; retains exploratory status and all previous results.
current_main_validation.limitations: Convergent evidence in automated review reports, not independent vacancy ground truth; adjusted associations remain inconclusive.
current_main_validation.lourie_role: Supplementary economic benchmark; exact posting-based tests still require posting histories.

ranked_interview_operating_check.status: COMPLETED exploratory Lourie-motivated adaptation; not exact posting replication.
ranked_interview_operating_check.finding: Ranked interview counts do not reproduce a consistent positive growth signal; ghost interactions are inconclusive after correction. Exact posting-based test remains unestimated.
ranked_interview_operating_check.main_validation_unchanged: Separate-review check remains the main validation section.

review_proxy_multiverse.status: Completed exploratory comparison, 40 proxies and 1600 fits plus nested firm-group prediction.
review_proxy_multiverse.finding: No robust positive recruitment signal paired with negative ghost interaction; held-out-company prediction does not rescue the proposed economic check.

independent_original_measure_audit.interpretation: Separate-review agreement reproduced. Review-based economic interaction remains inconclusive; these results do not establish that the ghost-job measure is invalid.

company_groups_and_timing_search.status: Completed exploratory search; all model records retained.
